step5_first_run.single_measurement_note: n=1. Not a finding. TTFT 0.398 s, e2e 4.621 s, decode 30.1 tok/s for one request.

step5_first_run.estimator_cross_check_2: 333,904 tokens x 28,672 bytes = 8.9163 GiB vs engine-reported 8.92 GiB
step5_first_run.pool_size_note: The cache pool was 8.92 GiB here versus 8.68 GiB in the max_model_len 4096 smoke test, because vLLM's startup profiling measured a different peak activation (0.23 vs 0.48 GiB). Cache capacity therefore depends on the max_model_len the server is launched with.

estimator_cross_check.reading: The analytical estimate reproduces the engine-reported cache capacity to within rounding for this configuration. This is one data point and supports H4; it does not prove it generally.

open_items: Launch the server ONCE with a fixed max_model_len (32768) for the whole sweep so cache capacity is identical across cells
Add a warmup request at each context length (a 37-token warmup does not warm the shapes of a 1K-32K prefill)
Decide benchmark-time vLLM settings: max_model_len (32768 for the long-context cells), prefix caching off, enforce_eager or not
Commit a dependency lock for the key packages (configs/requirements.lock.txt)
